title: Pullback
description: JSON Schema for a pullback — the universal cone over a cospan (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §4; Awodey 2010 §5.5). Given two morphisms f : A → C and g : B → C sharing a common codomain (a cospan), the pullback is an object P with two projection morphisms π_1 : P → A and π_2 : P → B such that f ∘ π_1 = g ∘ π_2, and universal among such squares. The aliases-as-resolve-pullbacks theorem expresses alias-equivalence as a pullback of classical equality along the resolve function ρ — this schema is the typed home of that theorem's statement.

cospan.description: The cospan f : A → C, g : B → C — two morphisms sharing a common codomain. Exactly two; the same-codomain condition is checked by a separate transformer.

pullback-object.description: The pullback object P = A ×_C B.

left-projection.description: The projection morphism π_1 : P → A.

right-projection.description: The projection morphism π_2 : P → B.
